objective: Find the largest defensible post-challenge/demo backtest expansion across any event universe, not limited to earnings, equities, or the original competition protocol.

scope_change.old_scope: EARNINGS_EPS / equity-return economic backtest / scientific competition protocol
scope_change.new_scope: unrestricted presentation/demo expansion across prediction-market, macro, corporate, regulatory, political, sports, crypto, and other event families
allowed_changes_for_demo: change from equity-return PnL to prediction-market-contract PnL
use market-internal token price history instead of external security prices
prioritize N and demonstrability over confirmatory scientific purity
keep clear labeling that this is a post-challenge demo/backtest expansion
still_not_allowed: present demo results as the frozen competition result
claim deployable alpha without out-of-sample/fee/liquidity controls
mix outcome data into signal construction

polymarket_census.status: largest_existing_event_source; not yet backtest because price/settlement/history join is needed

forecastex_contracts.status: large existing contract source; likely harder to backtest because contract discovery/market data route is broker/API-dependent

fda_truth_extension.status: domain-interesting but not a large-N demo route

route_ranking.universe: All tradable/resolved Polymarket markets from the existing W4B census, across categories
route_ranking.expected_n_potential: highest among existing repo sources; starts from 810515 census rows before filters
route_ranking.backtest_target: prediction-market contract/token return or settlement return
route_ranking.why_it_expands: Removes ticker/equity-price bottleneck; every market can be evaluated from its own token price history when CLOB token IDs and history are available.
required_joins: token id -> price history before decision timestamp
token id/market -> close/settlement/resolution or terminal proxy
timestamped signal snapshot -> later contract return
route_ranking.presentation_strength: Shows the ARGOS architecture working at platform scale; largest-N demo path.
route_ranking.main_caveat: This is no longer equity alpha; it is prediction-market contract PnL/calibration.

route_ranking.universe: Kalshi markets/events using current and historical endpoints
route_ranking.expected_n_potential: high, but requires fresh platform-specific collection
route_ranking.why_it_expands: Uses direct event-contract market data instead of equity tickers; supports historical trades/candlesticks.
route_ranking.presentation_strength: Regulated prediction-market venue and clean historical endpoints.
route_ranking.main_caveat: Less already materialized in repo than Polymarket; may require API auth/limits handling.

route_ranking.universe: Recurring macro announcements and/or prediction-market contracts around macro releases

route_ranking.backtest_target: PM contract return or ETF/futures proxy return
route_ranking.why_it_expands: Generalizes beyond earnings while staying financially interpretable.
route_ranking.main_caveat: More collection work and lower N than all-event PM route.

route_ranking.backtest_target: biotech equity return or PM contract return

required_joins: FDA event -> ticker/issuer or PM market
route_ranking.main_caveat: Not the largest-N route with current data.

route_ranking.universe: ForecastEx/IBKR event contracts from existing W4B contract census
route_ranking.expected_n_potential: high in raw rows; execution harder

route_ranking.universe: Original W2A/EXP06 equity-event pipeline plus possible non-earnings event families
route_ranking.expected_n_potential: bounded unless original raw EXP06 artifacts are recovered or full pipeline is rerun
route_ranking.why_it_expands: Closest to original story, but bottlenecked by event->ticker->PIT->price joins.
required_joins: recover raw EXP06/EXP06R files or rerun W2A pipeline

steps: Use existing W4B Polymarket census as the broad universe.
Extract market/event IDs, condition IDs, token IDs, end/resolution timestamps, category metadata where available.
Fetch/derive token price history before observation cutoff using Polymarket CLOB price-history or batch-prices-history where IDs are available.
Define simple pre-registered demo rules: buy YES/NO or abstain from probability threshold, hold to close/settlement or fixed horizon.
Report N at every funnel stage: census rows, unique markets, markets with token ID, markets with pre-cutoff price history, markets with terminal outcome/price, executable demo trades.
Keep separate from competition artifacts and label as post-challenge demo expansion.
recommended_next_execution.expected_story_if_successful: The original equity backtest was constrained by ticker/PIT coverage; the unrestricted demo shows the same ARGOS event-signal-backtest machinery scaling across prediction-market contracts directly.
